Container.Name: mokuro-bunko
Container.Overview: Mokuro Bunko: self-hosted manga library server for Mokuro Reader (WebDAV, catalog, accounts) with local OCR. The image carries no OCR backend: the server answers within seconds of the first start and meanwhile, in the background, detects the GPU the container is given and downloads the matching backend into Library Data (about 2 GB for an NVIDIA GPU, 3 GB for AMD, 100 MB for the CPU), then the OCR models (progress in the log and the admin panel; local OCR starts by itself when done); later starts reuse them. First admin: the log prints a one-time setup code for http://[IP]:[PORT]/setup, or fill in Admin username and Admin password. NVIDIA: keep --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters and install the Nvidia-Driver plugin (driver >= 580, Turing / GTX 16xx / RTX 20xx or newer). AMD (RX 6000/7000/9000): replace Extra Parameters with --device=/dev/kfd --device=/dev/dri. No GPU: clear Extra Parameters; OCR runs on the CPU. For a server without local OCR use the mokuro-bunko-lite template. Tags: beta (the default while 0.7 is in beta) follows the newest release, beta or stable; latest follows stable releases from 0.7.0 on (latest-cuda is the same image, for templates made for the 0.5.2 CUDA image); pin a version with e.g. 0.7.0-beta.5. Settings left empty fall back to config.yaml.
Container.Requires: For NVIDIA OCR: the Unraid Nvidia-Driver plugin (driver >= 580). For AMD OCR: the amdgpu driver (/dev/kfd).

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for mokuro-bunko

Config.Name: Library Data
Config.Description: Persistent library storage (library, database, logs, OCR backend and models)

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Config directory (config.yaml lives here)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as (Unraid nobody=99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as (Unraid users=100)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Umask for created files

Config.Name: TAKE_OWNERSHIP
Config.Description: Set true to chown /data and /config to PUID:PGID on boot

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Optional: create this admin account on the first start (ignored once an admin exists). Leave empty to create it in the browser at /setup with the one-time setup code from the container's log.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional: the password for Admin username (at least 8 characters; only used on the first start).

Config.Name: MOKURO_CONFIG
Config.Description: Config file path

Config.Name: MOKURO_HOST
Config.Description: Bind host

Config.Name: MOKURO_PORT
Config.Description: Bind port (public port when the nginx offload is on)

Config.Name: MOKURO_STORAGE
Config.Description: Storage base path inside container

Config.Name: nginx download offload
Config.Description: 1: run the bundled nginx in front and serve library downloads with X-Accel-Redirect (as in 0.5); 0: the server serves them itself

Config.Name: OCR Backend
Config.Description: auto|cuda|rocm|cpu|skip: auto uses the GPU the container is given; cpu stays on the CPU; skip runs no OCR here (nothing is downloaded). Decides which OCR backend is downloaded (in the background, after the server is up).

Config.Name: OCR Auto Install
Config.Description: true: download the OCR backend for this container's GPU in the background when it is missing (the server serves meanwhile); false: never by itself (the admin panel shows it missing, with an Install button)

Config.Name: OCR Generations
Config.Description: Leave empty to use config.yaml, or the JSON list of OCR generations. Engines: hayai-nova, paddle-manga, ppocr-manga. Easier to edit in the admin panel (OCR - Generations).

Config.Name: OCR Local Processing
Config.Description: false: this container runs no OCR and waits for a remote processor (mokuro-bunko processor serve) to log in

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU visibility for the NVIDIA runtime (NVIDIA only)

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: NVIDIA driver capabilities
